description: Get current, human-verified pricing for a specific answering service, virtual receptionist or AI receptionist (e.g. Smith.ai, Ruby, Dialzara, Abby Connect, AnswerConnect). Returns every plan with monthly price, included minutes, setup fees, overage rates, free trial, plus the date the pricing was last verified on the vendor’s own site. Use when someone asks "how much does X cost", "X pricing", "is X worth it", or asks for alternatives to a named service. Covers 22 services, updated weekly.
name: get_answering_service_pricing
title: Answering service pricing lookup
